lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Sensor Tower estimates 7.71m digital GTA VI pre-orders worth about $751m through about Nov 3, an average of roughly $97 a copy. Weekly pre-orders accelerated to about 790k from 470k the week before, and in August 89% of pre-orders were the $99.99 Ultimate Edition. Wells Fargo estimates the $8.0-8.2bn FY27 guide assumes 33m copies at $80. findings.finding: Funding test. The Q2 10-Q asserted it is 'probable' liquidity covers obligations for one year from issuance with $3.0B of liquidity ($775M cash and investments, about $1.98B undrawn DDTL, $270M ABL). The money funds losses, not a ramp (production down 38%, deliveries down 4% QoQ), so it is likely to need either new PIF or third-party funding announced with the print, which would be dilutive at $3.5 against the $8.32 Uber and $10.65 Series C prices of April, or weaker liquidity language.

findings.finding: FY2026 guide arithmetic: Q1 +26.4% cc (CHF 831.9m), Q2 +21.6% cc (850.3m) and Q3 ~+17% cc put nine months at ~21.5% cc. A 'low-20%' FY on 2025's CHF 3,014m therefore needs Q4 growth of ~15% (for 20%) to ~23% (for 22%). With wholesale sell-in deliberately throttled and Q3 decelerating 4-5 points a quarter, the FY guide is at risk of being narrowed to the low end or cut; that, rather than Q3, is the line the stock trades on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has driven every large reaction: guide cut on 2026-08-11, -20.3%; first 2026 guide below consensus on 2026-03-03, -6.1%; guide raise on 2025-11-12, about +20%.
